notes.title: Riptale Hotfix - 24.5.2017
notes.notes:
- Changed Display Settings menu header to what it should be
- Twins should no longer deal damage after they die
- Physics Blood settings should now be correctly defaulted to "High" instead of "Off"

In case you're wondering why the heck your precious red life liquids are not smearing the walls, check settings from Main Menu -> Options -> Display Settings -> Physics Blood.

notes.title: Riptale Patch - v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Patch notes v1.0.3

- Made some slight adjustments to main menu, like moving button prompts more towards bottom corner and added a version number
- Options menu has had some changes, all display and graphic-related options have been moved under a single option window
- You can now select window size up to 4x normal size
- You can now select the amount of physics blood from off - low - medium - high. High is default.
- You can now select a faded colors mode
- Necro Dragon's max minion count has been raised from 4 to 5
- Necro Dragon's minions' speed reduced
- Necro Dragon's minions now have an unique death animation
- Necro Dragon's minions' spawning now has an animation, indicating where the spawning will take place
- Necro Dragon's teleport spell has been adjusted and should no longer teleport too close to player
- Necro Dragon will no longer take extra hits from same attack during slow-motion
- Adjusted enemy spawning in a way that should prevent from player falling into a cluster of enemies when entering a new room from the top
- Peeks (teleporting enemies in Underground Forest) should no longer get stuck in walls, ceiling or floor
- Peeks should no longer teleport right in player's location
- Player should no longer be able to take damage right after starting the room clearing challenge that includes Blades (bouncing enemies)

EDIT:

- As an added bonus, a screen color filter unlock system was added to the game. Unlocked screen filters and faded color scheme can now be accessed from unlock menu.
- You may unlock new screen color filters by advancing further in the game. 
- A timer has been added to the game. Timer will be visible when a boss has been killed, player is killed or game is completed.
- Button prompts have been added to options/unlock menus
- Adjusted Peeks' behaviour a little bit, in attempt to make it less annoying. It is still quite annoying.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Riptale Patch - v.1.0.2
notes.notes:
Patch notes v1.0.2

- Fixed a bug that caused challenge rooms not presenting player the trinket chest after winning the challenge.
- Added some enemies an idle animation.
- Added an animation to the challenge pineapples.
- Added challenge room pineapples a pick-up sound, you know, the sound that pineapples make.
- Fixed inconsistencies in Dragon Cultist damage pattern.
- Fixed a bug where player was able to walk through Dragon Knights even though they shouldn't.
- Fixed a bug where a door was placed incorrectly in one of the challenges.
- Fixed typos in challenge text boxes.
- Enemies in challenge rooms no longer drop loot.
- Boss minions no longer drop money. They may still drop health pickups.
- Homing attack gained a new animation and its hitbox has been reduced drastically.
- Added new sound effects and updated some music files.
- D-pad controls should now work properly when selected from control bindings.
- Fixed a bug relating to d-pad that caused game to crash.
- Added a tiny deadzone to gamepad thumbstick controls to reduce control-related problems.
- Extra health cannot be picked up when in full health any longer.
- The ambient sound in transition rooms should no longer start really loudly.
- Player should no longer die when picking up "Steel Your Precision" rune in hard mode.
- Game now starts in fullscreen by default.
- Fixed a bug where player was able to fall down left and right side doorways.
- Touching health pickups when in full health now reveals player's health.

notes.title: Riptale Patch - v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Patch notes v1.0.1

- Added music to intro.
- Added music to library.
- Added a fanfare jingle when winning a challenge.
- Combos will now yield gold.

- Fixed a bug where game crashed after gaining reward for getting all trinkets.
- Fixed a bug where gems were reset by combos way too often.
- Fixed a bug where game crashed when player dies during certain challenge rooms.
- "Snider" should no longer shoot fireballs off frame (Underground Forest).
- Fixed and tweaked a bunch of smaller, less menacing bugs.

Also, a hotfix was sent last weekend, containing:
- Fixed a bug where completing any of the three starting areas yielded only the achievement for Mushroom Caverns.
- Fixed a bug where you could get "Like an Absolute Madman" by completing game first on normal mode then immediately entering hardmode afterwards.
- Few other smaller fixes.
